images.screen: A · 세 번째 재생 — pressing play again, knowing it stretches
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down view of a warm wooden kitchen table in late-afternoon sunlight, soft diagonal window light, heavy film grain and a faint orange light leak in the corner, like a faded 1990s photograph. In the center, a silver-beige portable cassette player with a speaker grille and chunky piano-key buttons (the red play key pressed) holds a cassette whose cream label is handwritten in blue ink "엄마 — 98 생일", reels visible through the window. Beside it, a tilted polaroid of a mother in a red cardigan and a little girl with pigtails behind a birthday cake with candles, captioned in handwriting. A pinned cream note card in serif type shows the play count "3번째" and "남은 목소리 71%" with a small bar. Below the player, a soft amber waveform strip, and a subtitle in thin white serif "생일 축하해, 우리 딸." with slightly widened letter spacing. A round cream play button with a hint. Nostalgic, tender, quietly aching.

images.screen: B · 열한 번째 재생 — the voice has almost stretched away
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same wooden table seen from above, now at dusk: desaturated, cool blue-grey light, heavy vignette and film grain. The cassette lies askew beside the player whose door hangs open, and a long ribbon of brown magnetic tape has been pulled out and loops loosely across the table in soft curves, crinkled in places. A coffee cup sits half out of frame at the lower-left. A grey faded note card reads "11번째" and "남은 목소리 4%" with an almost empty bar. Across the middle, the subtitle has stretched into a few widely spaced, blurred, fading syllables "생 … 해 … 딸". At the bottom, two quiet choices in thin serif Korean, "한 번 더 듣는다" highlighted and "여기서 멈춘다" dim. Elegiac, minimal, emotional climax of loss. Continuity: the player is the same silver-beige portable cassette player from image A (no brand logo, not black, no SONY), and the cassette label is the same handwritten blue-ink "엄마 — 98 생일"; no other label text.
